description.value:
You collapse probabilistic variance in a sphere around you, enforcing strict determinism. While this spell is sustained, all creatures inside the 30-foot emanation, ally and enemy alike, treat random rolls as if they had rolled the median value on each die, rounding down: 2 on a d4, 3 on a d6, 4 on a d8, 5 on a d10, and 6 on a d12. This affects all dice rolls that occur entirely within the emanation: skill checks, attack rolls, damage rolls, and saving throw rolls.

If you are sustaining both this spell and Sphere of Ruin, attempts to counteract this spell take a -2 circumstance penalty.

Heightened (+2) The emanation's radius doubles.
